summary: v10.6.1 frontend verification at 390x844 plus a backend GET check. Everything requested is implemented and working: dashboard header shows 'Ver 10.6.1'. On /trades-position and on the /asi-bot Recent Trades list, the status badge sits at the top-right of row 1, directly above PnL (checked by measuring element positions on real data: badge y=226, PnL y=246, same right edge). /copy-trade cards show ISOLATED, AC x%, Margin $x and the formula tag. REVERSE buttons were not shown because all 25 leaderboard rows are closed, which is correct. /asset/crypto/AVAX (AI=LONG) shows a red 'REVERSE: Short with ASI-Bot' button and SAND (AI=SHORT) shows a green 'REVERSE: Long with ASI-Bot' button (testID asset-asi-reverse). The old yellow 'Trade with ASI-Bot' button is gone. The asi-reverse-toggle exists. No red screen and no app page errors. GET /api/asi/leaderboard/live returns 200, and every one of the 25 items has auto_close_pct, margin_mode, formula_tag and tp_count, with no _id. No pending_entry trades exist in the DB, so the yellow LIMIT border could only be checked in code (YELLOW #F0B90B border plus LIMIT badge). No execute, reverse or close buttons were tapped.

minor.issue: The ranking is all-time and only includes positions with pnl_usdt > 0 (pnl.py:99-109). The 25th place currently needs about $61.64, so an OPEN position almost never makes the list and the new REVERSE button on /copy-trade is practically never visible. The user's current open XTZ position (+$24.78) is not listed. The route docstring says 'only traders CURRENTLY in open positions', which is out of date.

ui_bugs.issue: Raw internal codes are shown in the card header: 'Closed on position_closed_externally' and 'Closed on manual_close_all'. The mapping in copy-trade.tsx:256-267 is missing position_closed_externally, manual_close_all, TRAILING and BREAK_EVEN, which trades-position.tsx and asi-bot.tsx already handle.
For low-priced coins, toLocaleString() rounds prices to 3 decimals (ROSE shows Entry $0.007 · SL 0.007 · TP 0.007), so SL and TP look identical. Use the existing fp() formatter.
The chip says 'ACTIVE' (i18n asi_status_active) while /trades-position says 'OPEN'. The user asked for OPEN/CLOSED/LIMIT, so the two screens disagree.

issues: The status badge's right edge (x=367/363) is about 7px further right than the PnL text (x=360/357) because of the PnL container's paddingHorizontal 7. This is cosmetic and could be aligned.
The status badge/chip has no testID.
The subtitle says 'Top 25 positions by 24h profit' but the backend ranks all-time.

action_items: Decide how OPEN positions get onto the leaderboard (e.g. always include open positions, or a separate open section). Otherwise the REVERSE: SHORT/LONG button on /copy-trade is effectively unreachable.
Add position_closed_externally ('Closed on exchange'), manual_close_all, TRAILING and BREAK_EVEN to closedReasonText in copy-trade.tsx.
Format leaderboard SL/TP/Entry with fp() instead of toLocaleString() for sub-$1 coins.
Align the asi-bot chip label (ACTIVE) with OPEN, or confirm that ACTIVE is intended.
Add testIDs to the status badges (e.g. tp-status-badge-{id}, asi-status-chip-{id}).

Asset REVERSE (symbol.tsx:1514-1522) builds TP2/TP3 as entry ± spread*2/3, which differs from the Target 2/3 the UI displays (AVAX shows 9.0119 but REVERSE uses ~9.0178). Unlike copy-trade it also has no duplicate-position check before a 1-tap real order. Consider using the displayed targets and adding the dup check.
critical_code_review_comments: quickExecute.reverseLevels: if origEntry is 0 or the SL is null (Number(null)=0, so pct=100%), SL becomes 0 or 2x entry. Add a guard for missing levels.
reverseLevels mirrors the original SL/TP distances, so a reversed trade inherits the original R:R (e.g. 1:0.31 on AVAX). This is a business-logic choice to confirm.
trades-position.tsx is 901 lines, asi-bot.tsx 1982 and symbol.tsx 1887. All are over 700 lines and should be split.
